title: Bridge-mode A/B orchestration for pinned model revisions (metric-first safety gates)
creator: Leah Chen
description:
Problem: When we publish new model revisions that are pinned for customers we need a safe, observable path to validate quality and performance before full promotion. Existing canary patterns (shadow + gradual split) are doubling validation efforts and leave blind spots for request-level divergence.

Proposal: Implement a "bridge-mode" orchestration layer that combines shadowing, per-request A/B compare, and incremental live-bridge routing. Bridge-mode uses metric-first safety gates (quality deltas + latency/cost SLOs) and groups traffic into ephemeral micro-buckets for cohorted A/B validation. The system must integrate with pinning semantics so customers with pinned model policies can opt into staged promotion without losing isolation guarantees.

Goals:
- Reduce time-to-confidence for pinned model promotions while preserving customer SLAs.
- Automate safe promotion/rollback decisions using defined signal thresholds.
- Provide per-pin, per-variant dashboards and explainable rollback signatures for audits.
acceptance_criteria: Bridge-mode can be enabled for a pinned model via pin config flag (console + API)
Ability to create ephemeral micro-buckets (1k-10k users or fixed-weight buckets) and run A/B for a configurable window
Automated gate evaluation: quality delta, hallucination proxy, latency P95, and token-cost delta evaluated every minute
If any gate crosses critical threshold, traffic for the affected micro-bucket is auto-shifted back to control and an alert + rollback signature is emitted
Telemetry: per-request A/B diffs, cohorted pass/fail rates, and deterministic rollback reasons stored for 90 days
E2E test harness that simulates mismatched outputs to validate detection and rollback behavior
Documentation and runbook published (Console docs + Runbook link) and two internal teams have signed off
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Canary labs): internal-only shadow+compare for 48h using sample test harness (ENG-5022)
Phase 1 (Micro-buckets): allow opt-in micro-buckets up to 2% traffic for pinned customers; gates run every 1 minute; duration 24h
Phase 2 (Bridge warm): increase to 10% traffic for low-risk pins with runbook sign-off; enable automated roll-forward if gates stable for 12h
Phase 3 (Promote): subject to PM approval and customer opt-in, promote revision and publish new performance profile
Phase 4 (Observe & revert): 7-day post-promote monitoring window with automatic snapshotting and rollback signature retention
monitoring_signals: Quality delta: eval-set semantic similarity (avg and 5th percentile) and user-feedback rate
Hallucination proxy: factualness heuristics / fact-checking hits per 1k responses
Latency: P50/P95/P99 (end-to-end) and model inference-only P95
Cost: tokens-per-response and per-token cost delta versus control
Error rate: API 5xxs and inference failures
Distributional drift: token ngram / embedding centroid shift per micro-bucket
rollback_playbook: Auto-rollback when any critical gate breaches: immediately shift affected micro-buckets back to control and mark revision 'suspended' for that pin
Human-in-the-loop: paging to on-call with prefilled rollback checklist and causal signal bundle
Post-incident triage: collect A/B diffs, top failing prompts, and resource/latency traces; create ENG incident with tag 'bridge-rollback'
If repeated false-positives occur, tune gate thresholds and provenance (eval set coverage) before retry
For customer-visible rollbacks, notify customers via Console activity feed and include rollback signature + short explanation
